brief: Three bases arranged around an empty spot, with a bay tray standing in that spot.

requirements.requirement: Three bases arranged around an empty spot
requirements.evidence: Pieces at 1,0,0 ; 0,1,0 ; -1,1,0 leave cell 0,0,0 empty and surround it on three sides

requirements.requirement: Bay tray standing in that empty spot
requirements.evidence: bay:0#0,0#bay4 = hex-bin-bay-s-full-solid placed via addNotch at 0,0 level 0 k=4 spanning the gap between the three bases

finish.summary: Built three full bases in a U/arc around 0,0,0 leaving it empty, then seated a full solid bay tray in the central gap (addNotch at 0,0 k4). Capped open faces and locked joints; mesh clear.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
